title.rendered: Download PBA 2k18 Apk Obb 1.4 For Android

content.rendered:
Download the latest PBA 2k18 Apk Obb data for Android, it is a popular Philippines Basketball game.

This year version come with latest features that are so fascinating and interesting to the fans of PBA 2k series on Android.

From the screenshot below you can see how the players appear similar to the ones you see in real life, all of them have various kinds of basketball ball skills that you could ever dream of such as free throws, spider dunk, blocking, dribbling and many more.

PBA 2k18 Apk was modded based on the previous year version adding more leagues, players drafting, New players added also, with new designs to the arena making the game to look so beautiful and nice.

PBA 2k18 Apk and obb is so easy to install on your Android device, you just need to move all the necessary files to your phone storage and start playing, further more you can read more about how to install the game when you scroll down towards the end of this post.

Download

PBA 2k18 Apk (53MB)

PBA 2k18 Obb (1.90GB)

Password: apkgamers.org

Game Requirements

Minimum of 512 RAM is needed to run this game, with minimum of 1 GHz, 2 cores CPU, 5 inch screen size Android device.

How To Install PBA 2k18 Apk Android

Just follow the simple steps below to install PBA basketball game:

1. Extract the obb file using zarchiver into storage/Android/obb folder.
2. Install the Apk app into phone memory and start playing the game.
